mapper.sql: id, rule_name, rule_type, condition_value, vip_days, auto_grant, total_limit, granted_count, daily_limit, status, description, sort_order, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vip_gift_rule (rule_name, rule_type, condition_value, vip_days, auto_grant, total_limit, daily_limit, status, description, sort_order) VALUES (#{ruleName}, #{ruleType}, #{conditionValue}, #{vipDays}, #{autoGrant}, #{totalLimit}, #{dailyLimit}, #{status}, #{description}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vip_gift_record WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
